Completed batch 55: authored both pages and all 23 assigned items, and created the manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch evidence, notes, and readiness records.

The broad weak-null theorem remains **escalated**. The available 2011 coupling proof requires assignment-wise centering that the plan’s weak null does not imply; the 2013 supplement is unavailable. I recorded the proposed missing supplier, `thm-two-sample-u-statistic-permutation-clt-under-weak-null`. I also documented the plan’s extra-\(\sqrt m\) scaling conflict and added a counterexample showing that scaling diverges for the stated standard-error pivot. The other 22 items are recorded ready.

Final scoped checks passed: precheck (19 proof-bearing items), proof layout (23 items, 87 steps), rendering (25 files), depcheck, content policy, strict proof contracts, coverage (19 harvested results), source fetch (4/4 stamped), and dependency levels (0–7, no cycles). The selected readiness audit found no stale hashes.
